title: Quality product, but a little hard to assemble
text: Quality product, but a little hard to assemble. I never had an office chair that was quite as difficult to assemble as this was.  It is not complicated, as there is an illustrated guide, but I found the wheels difficult to insert, as they were a tight fit.  That's good, as they won't be likely to come loose.  I also got confused as to which screws went into which holes and I had to actually remove some screws and redo.  I finally figured out that the screws are numbered on the assembly diagram and on the corresponding cardboard that they are attached to.  It would have saved some time and trouble had I realized that at first.  The real problem that I encountered is that the screws designated to hold the arms to the back of the chair were too long.  I had to actually cut them off with a hacksaw to get them in far enough to get the trim strip to cover the heads.  That was a little surprising and frustrating, since all the other screws went in fine.  That problem is why I knocked off one star on my rating.  Also, I found it hard to attach the back; struggled with it for a while to get it positioned correctly.  There are some extra screws included in case you lose one or more.  Also, they include an Allen wrench to put the screws in with, so you don't need any other tools (unless you have to cut off some screws, as I did).  This is a good quality chair for the money and it seems very durable and well made.  Haven't decided yet how comfortable it is, as it takes time to adjust to a new chair.  It does appear to have some lumbar support for the lower back.  Not having lumbar support in my current chair, makes it a little uncomfortable at first, but I think over time, it is a good thing and will help anyone who sits a lot, as I do.  The chair is adjustable on height, as almost all office chairs are.  There is no adjustment on the arm height, but not expected for the price of the chair.  Also note that the arms are a hard material and not padded.  They seemed comfortable enough, but my current office chair has padded arms.  The chair is basic black, but quite attractive.  A good chair for the price.  If you want more features, like adjustable arms, you will pay more.  UPDATE:  I have used this chair for a while now and find it to be very comfortable; more so than other chairs in the same price range.  I am abandoning my old office chair and using this one exclusively now.  5 stars on comfort; the lumbar support is great.
